summary: The proof contains a false strict inequality in (26). The claimed area bound appears locally repairable, but the submitted proof is not error-free as written.
critical_errors: Equation (26) asserts 5(X_0^2+rho^2)>10X_0 rho. In fact the sum-of-squares identity gives only 5(X_0^2+rho^2)>=10X_0 rho, with equality when X_0=rho. This equality occurs in the stated domain at rho=(5+sqrt(5))/20, where the displayed strict inequality is false.
repair_hints: Replace the first strict inequality in (26) by a weak inequality. Since (25) still gives 10X_0 rho>1, and (23) is already strictly larger than 5(X_0^2+rho^2) because p>1/5, the required conclusion R_2>1 remains available.
